description: This file defines a custom LinearLayout called CheckableLinearLayout that implements the Checkable interface, allowing it to maintain and toggle a checked state suitable for use in checkable list item views.

classes.name: CheckableLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that implements Checkable, enabling it to display a checked/unchecked state.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns whether the layout is currently checked.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state and updates the drawable state if changed.

methods.name: onCreateDrawableState
methods.description: Creates and merges the checked state into the drawable state array.
